title: SkillLocator
description: Where the Skill Resolver Service reads full skill packages (SKILL.md + package tree). lfs = skill/program code on the container filesystem. blob = object storage when skills are promoted for singleton API or serverless execution. One authoritative backend per skill version.

backend.description: lfs = container-local skill tree; blob = object store for serverless / singleton API

version.description: Semver when not encoded in uri

checksum.description: Optional content digest of package root / SKILL.md+yaml
